subject: Important Update: Your upcoming flight details
body: Dear valued customer, we would like to inform you that there has been a slight change in the departure time of your upcoming flight. Your flight to Paris will now depart at 10:30 AM instead of the original 9:00 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline!
